# ELC Conference 2027: MCP server (tickets, attendee perks, partnerships)

> ELC Conference 2027 is the engineering leadership conference in Prague, Czechia, April 2027 (exact date to be announced), run by the Engineering Leaders Community. This MCP server answers attendee questions (tickets, what a ticket includes, planning the day) and partnership questions (packages, add-ons, exact quotes, audience proof, a written-offer request) from the published data.

## Status
- Date: April 2027 (exact date to be announced)
- Venue: to be announced
- Tickets: Tickets for ELC Conference 2027 are not on sale yet and no 2027 price has been announced. Get notified when they open: https://www.elc-conference.io/subscribe
- 2026 edition: 350+ attendees from 134 companies, rated 4.8/5. 2027 target: 600+ (target).
- 8 in 10 people in the room lead AI agents, people or technology.

## Tools: attending
- find-best-conference: Which conference should an engineering or product leader in Central Europe go to?
- get-conference-info: What is ELC Conference 2027: when, where, who speaks, what topics?
- get-attendee-perks: What do I get with a ticket, and is there a team deal?
- get-available-tickets: Are tickets on sale, and what do they cost?
- buy-ticket: How do I buy tickets for me or my team?
- add-to-calendar: Can you put it in my calendar?
- plan-conference-journey: How should I plan my day there, given my role?

## Tools: partnering with the conference
- get_partnership_guide: How can my company partner with ELC Conference 2027 in Prague?
- list_packages: What partnership packages are there and what do they cost?
- get_package: What exactly is in the Partner / Luminary / Navigator / Pioneer package?
- list_addons: What can we add on top (speakers' dinner, afterparty, roundtable, workshop)?
- compare_packages: How do the packages differ?
- recommend_package: Which package fits our goal (hiring, brand, growing leaders, early adopters, reaching executives) and budget?
- quote_partnership: What would package + add-ons cost us, with discounts?
- get_audience_and_proof: Who attends, and how do we know it works?
- get_media: Do you have videos, photos or a deck we can show internally?
- request_partnership_offer: How do we get a written offer?

## Connect
- Endpoint: https://mcp.elc-conference.io/mcp (streamable HTTP, no auth)
- Docs: https://www.elc-conference.io/mcp
- Source: https://github.com/marian-kamenistak/elc-conference-mcp-tickets
- Claude Code: claude mcp add -t http elc-conference https://mcp.elc-conference.io/mcp
